title: AUTO-LEARNING-LOOP-MS0
brief: User directive (Phase-6): "we need an auto feature that monitors reputable sources multiple times a day so our system automatically does deep research and decides if and how we can utilize new features to our system and synergize it automatically and auto add it to the system-viz feature."

shipped.title: NoveltyDetectionEngine + dispatcher action novelty_detect (3-tier dedup: exact-hash / cosine 0.92 / Jaccard 0.50 fallback)
shipped.tests: 50/50 engine + 8/8 wiring = 58/58 pass; tsc clean for U-ALL02 files (pre-existing unrelated errors persist in telemetry/tenant/shopPractice dispatchers)
shipped.scrutiny: Per-file gate (2 parallel reviewers on engine): both PASS. P1 fixes applied inline: bestCosine -Infinity init + Number.isFinite guard, validateCatalog Number.isFinite (rejects ±Infinity), __proto__/constructor/prototype key rejection, addVerifiedNovel returns {added,embeddedFailures,skipped}, _computedEmbedding threaded (no double-embed), isCatalogLoaded flag, deepCloneState explicit-named-construction, normalize entity-strip extended to numeric forms, cosine import COUPLING annotation, WIRE-EXEMPT tag on singleton.
shipped.design: Three-tier dedup pipeline. Read-isolated via state.entries.slice() at t0. Engine owns in-memory CatalogState; CLI (deferred) owns JSONL persistence + .previous.json backup rotation. Dispatcher action novelty_detect: { items, commit? } → { detect: DetectResult, add?: AddOutcome, catalogLoaded: bool }.
shipped.spec_deviation: Auto-learn catalog routed to state/shared/auto-learning/source-novelty-catalog.json (the spec-named path state/shared/system-viz/novelty-catalog.json already holds a different v1.0.0 PRISM-internal schema, ~51KB / 207 entries).
deferred_followups: CLI cron entry (scripts/novelty-detect-sweep.mjs) + Windows installer — defer until U-ALL03 lands so the cron has a real consumer.
End-of-task 3-of-3 — engine/tests/wiring locally green (58/58); formal codex + reviewer-A + reviewer-B gate to be run during chat-bus close-out.

4th 24h-collision: files absorbed into peer commit f2c0ae42a [TRAINING-LEARNING-MS0]/U-TL-U3-CLOSEOUT-V2 — files correct + tracked; documented in memory reference_auto_learning_loop_ms0_u_all02_collision.md.
Envelope re-applied 2026-05-13T17:43Z after a peer chat reverted the first envelope flip — locking in via tight isolated commit on AUTO-LEARNING-LOOP-MS0.json only.

shipped.title: ReputableSourceMonitorEngine + CLI + cron + dispatcher (multi-source poller)
shipped.scrutiny: Per-file gate (4 reviewer agents): 2 P0 + 7 P1 + 5 test P1, ALL fixed inline. End-of-task 3-of-3 (session u-all01-1778689134): codex env-failed (provider rate-limit, escape hatch); Reviewer A PASS; Reviewer B PASS (caught CLI buf-out-of-scope ReferenceError, fixed inline).
shipped.design: Engine state per source: { etag, lastModified, lastSuccess, consecutiveFailures, backoffUntil }. Pure data engine — persistence (JSONL) lives in CLI; long-lived state (ETag/backoff) lives in MCP-server singleton via dispatcher. Sequential pollAll. MITM defense: response.url hostname compared to configured source hostname; mismatch raises alarm at threshold but does NOT advance backoff (avoids locking out legitimate-after-DNS-recovery sources).
deferred_followups: Live integration verification — operator must run `node scripts/source-monitor-sweep.mjs --once` and confirm ≥1 item per source.
CLI/engine parser drift — add parity test or shared parser module.
User-Agent string should accept `EngineOpts.userAgent` for downstream operators.
